# The symbols the macOS driver exports, without the leading underscore, in each slice of the
# universal library. Verification fails when a slice's exports differ from this list in either
# direction, and when an interface entry point (REDSHIFT_ODBC_ENTRY_POINTS in
# src/transport/odbc_driver.hpp) is not listed for both slices. A row is <name>, for both slices, or
# <name> <x86_64|arm64>, for one. Generated from the 2.3.1.0 library's export tries by
# tools/lib/macho.py exports <dylib>, which prints every row below, and reviewed as a whole on every
# driver update. A row also lets the driver bind its name by weak lookup (the weak-binds rule), so an
# added row is reviewed as that too.
#
# Unlike the Linux driver, which exports only its 110 SQL* functions, the macOS library exports the
# bundled libraries' symbols too: 14,478 in the x86_64 slice and 13,566 in the arm64 slice.
ACCESS_DESCRIPTION_free
ACCESS_DESCRIPTION_new
